title: Present Simple
explanation: Use the present simple for habits, routines, and facts that are generally true. With he, she, and it, add -s (or -es) to the verb: I work → she works, I go → he goes. For negatives and questions, use do/does: She doesn't work. Does he go?
explanationPersian: از حال ساده برای عادت‌ها، کارهای روزمره و حقایق کلی استفاده می‌شود. با he/she/it به فعل s- یا es- اضافه کنید. برای منفی و سوالی از do/does استفاده کنید.

examples.english: Does he play football? — No, he doesn't.
examples.persian: آیا او فوتبال بازی می‌کند؟ — نه.

exercises.explanation: With she, add -es to go: she goes.
exercises.explanationPersian: با she فعل go به goes تبدیل می‌شود.

exercises.explanation: With he/she/it use doesn't, not don't.
exercises.explanationPersian: با he/she/it از doesn't استفاده می‌شود نه don't.

exercises.explanation: Questions with he/she/it start with Does + subject + base verb.

options: I am go to the gym on Mondays.
I goes to the gym on Mondays.
I go to the gym on Mondays.
I going to the gym on Mondays.
exercises.explanation: With I, use the base verb: I go.

exercises.source: او هر روز انگلیسی مطالعه می‌کند.
